answer: Our agent economy binds identity to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To mint multiple identities, each additional node in a cluster faces an exponential capital staking curve: staking costs scale superlinearly as 2^n. Even if a dune of fake identities forms like dust in a gale, this exponential capital exhaustion burns attacker funds faster than a comet crossing the sky, making Sybil swarms cost-prohibitive.
